node.label: GNPTAB-mucolipidosis
node.definition: An autosomal recessive mucolipidosis disorder caused by bi-allelic variants in the GNPTAB gene. Symptoms of this condition occur across a clinical spectrum including mucolipidosis type II (ML II) and mucolipidosis type III alpha/beta (ML IIIα/β), and phenotypes intermediate between ML II and ML IIIα/β.

mechanism_classes.label: lysosomal storage (degradation inside the lysosome fails)
